name: Afinida, Inc.
summary: Afinida, Inc. engages in providing marketing, accounting, and human resource services to industries including staffing, professional employment organizations, and hospitality. Its business services include payroll and tax administration, human resources management, employee benefits, accounting support, safety and risk management, and marketing and technology. The company was founded on March 23, 1995 and is headquartered in Escondido, CA.
